title: MOIRE APERTURE
description: Three analytic line fields are bent by directly draggable apertures. The anchors have inertia and asynchronous drift, so every intervention reorganizes the interference field instead of adding a cursor effect. Density, angle, shear and lens power produce visibly different optical regimes.

visual_finish.composition: three off-centre optical apertures bend a field of fine line lattices into large interference basins and quiet negative-space zones
visual_finish.material_model: projected monochrome geometry with ink-black line cores, paper-white field and restrained spectral registration at high interference
detail_scales: subpixel registration edges and paper grain
